programs.summary: Argentina prepaid Visa card issued by Digifin S.A. and integrated with Lemon. The prepaid card is distinct from Lemon's later Bitcoin-backed credit card and is funded from the user's available Lemon payment-account balance, with crypto conversion handled through the broader Lemon platform.

Argentina physical Visa credit card issued by Digifin S.A. and collateralized by crypto assets pledged by the user. Lemon launched the Bitcoin-backed credit product in January 2026 as a separate program from the prepaid Lemon Card.

U.S.-issued international prepaid Visa card linked to a Takenos USD balance, available in virtual and physical formats. Current Takenos terms require users to accept Rain provider terms, but the reviewed first-party material does not clearly identify Rain as the regulated issuer.

providers.summary: Argentina payment-services company that issues Lemon's prepaid card and the separate Lemon crypto-collateralized credit card under its first-party legal terms.

relations.scope_note: Digifin's current prepaid-card terms identify Digifin S.A. as the company issuing and providing the Tarjeta Prepaga Lemon. The 2021 historical launch date is recorded separately as a program event rather than asserted as the issuer-relation start date.
Lemon's launch-era and current documentation identify the Argentina prepaid Lemon Card as Visa.
Digifin's credit-card terms explicitly define the Lemon crypto-collateralized credit card as a physical credit card issued by Digifin S.A.
Digifin terms and Lemon's launch statement identify Visa as the network for the Bitcoin-backed credit-card program.
Current Takenos TakeCard terms require acceptance of Rain provider terms. This records the evidenced provider relationship without assigning Rain an issuer role.
Current Takenos help and product materials identify TakeCard as an international prepaid Visa card issued in the United States.

events.title: Lemon launches prepaid Visa Card in Argentina
events.description: Lemon's launch-era product article published November 8, 2021 introduced the Lemon Card as a Visa card for spending pesos or crypto. Later first-party retrospectives confirm that the prepaid Visa program launched in November 2021.

events.title: Lemon launches Bitcoin-backed Visa credit card
events.description: Lemon announced its Bitcoin-backed Visa credit card in Argentina on January 14, 2026, allowing a peso credit line to be secured with BTC without selling the BTC. Digifin's separate credit-card terms confirm the legal product and issuer structure.
